title: Floor plan engine input
description: Input contract for the 2D floor planning engine. All lengths are whole feet on a 1 ft grid. Room names must be unique within a request. The hallway is added by the engine and is not listed here.

plot.description: [width, length] of the plot in whole feet. Width runs east-west, length runs north-south when north is up.

setbacks.description: Gap to leave from each plot edge, in whole feet. Missing sides default to 0. The buildable area is the plot minus these gaps.

entrance.description: Real-world side of the plot where the main entrance is.

north.description: Which way north points on the plot drawing. Directions such as SE are real-world directions and are converted using this.

rooms.description: Rooms the user wants. Names must be unique, for example bedroom1 and bedroom2.

type.description: Room type. Decides the default min, preferred and max sizes from the room size table. dining and study use the living room sizes; utility, store, storage and laundry use the kitchen sizes.

zone.description: Preferred position on the 3x3 zone map of the buildable area, in real-world directions. Mid is the center cell.

zone_mode.description: must: the layout is rejected if this cannot hold. try: it only adds penalty points when missed. Ignored if zone is missing.

attached_to.description: Bathrooms only: name of the bedroom this bathroom is attached to. It must share a wall with that bedroom and does not need the hallway.

min.description: Optional [width, height] minimum in feet. Replaces the table value for this room.

max.description: Optional [width, height] maximum in feet. Replaces the table value for this room.

pins.description: Exact sizes fixed by the user, for example after an edit. A pinned value must stay inside that room's min and max, and the solver keeps it exactly.

room.description: Name of a room in the rooms list.
